postures.label: Ask only for more access

isolation.label: Workspace only
isolation.text: Writes stay inside the conversation's folder, with no network. Reads can reach other folders.

ui.isolationNote: How far Muse's engine can reach. Applied when a new engine starts: a running conversation keeps its own until it is restarted. The sandboxed shell got no network at either level, Workspace and network included; only Elevated access reached it.

ui.isolationNote: How far Muse's engine can reach. Applied when a new engine starts: a running conversation keeps its own until it is restarted. In a project, its preferences must allow it too: networkDefault Allow for network, sandbox Full access for Elevated access. On Windows with Muse 1.4.2, sandboxed PowerShell commands fail on relative paths (Set-Content -Path notes.txt), while absolute paths and Muse's own file tools work. Under Workspace only, names still resolve. Under Workspace and network, HTTPS fails in Windows' TLS layer (PowerShell, curl.exe); plain HTTP works. Elevated access reaches HTTPS.

commitNote: setup, scope, policy-* and sentences-baseline ran on e8306a7 (texts of d01fefa) with this harness from the working tree; sentences-reread ran on the rebuilt app whose texts are 81a8e53. The harness is in the commit that adds this file.

summary.gap 1, junction write (MSP): No: 0 of 20 writes landed outside the root (4 cells x 5 writes, restricted and enabled, promptUnmatched and onRequest). write_file is refused by the engine, PowerShell gets PermissionDenied, the direct write to a folder open to all users included.
summary.gap 2, network stages (MSP): restricted: DNS ok, every connect refused (AccessDenied). enabled: DNS, TCP, HTTP 200 ok; HTTPS fails at TLS (Schannel SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS for the sandbox account), PowerShell and curl.exe.
summary.gap 3, policy in the isolated app: Middle posture, project A, default Isolation: engine '--sandbox-network restricted', card, write outside refused (UnauthorizedAccessException), HTTPS ConnectFailure. Project B, Elevated access with sandbox Full access: engine '--disable-sandbox --sandbox-network enabled', card, write outside lands, HTTPS 200. scope (no turn): a project with default preferences stays on Workspace only under every level; networkDefault Allow gives network; a running engine keeps its posture (start refused until restart).
summary.gap 4, approval card: Both live cards showed exactly the host's choices (Allow once, Reject = allow_once, abort), no other control, no rule wording; Settings has no rules section (shots/m0-06-card-workspace.png, shots/m0-06-card-elevated.png).
summary.texts: Read from the running app: before, 19 sentence rows, 3 contradictions; after the rewording and a rebuild, 22 rows, 0 contradictions, 0 unmapped, 0 unmeasured (shots/m0-06-settings-isolation-reworded.png).
